'''Hurkwill''' was the former chief of security of [[Talaos City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. He assisted a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] strike team in circumventing the defenses of the local [[Hutt Embassy]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hurkwill is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
